text:
mika_hyun: Heads-up — Acme Health wants an air-gapped pilot. Key asks: USB/SSD delivery, incremental patches only (no full image cadence), signed manifests we can verify, and a clear rollforward/rollback policy to include in the SOW. Also need per-site offline support pricing and SLA for emergency hotfixes.

derek_gore: Short answer: we can do incremental (chunked) deltas + signed manifests. Caveats: some model shard formats don't delta well so we may have to ship full shard replacements occasionally. Agent min version for delta apply: 2.6.0.

anu_desai: Ops notes:
- apply command for demo: `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /media/usb/manifest.json --verify --dry-run`
- we provide sha256 checksums alongside bundles and a manifest.sig file.
- manifest verification supports customer root cert (PEM) or our signing key; HSM signing (PKCS#11) supported for enterprise.

eng-sales-bot: POC ticket created: POC-12577 assigned derek_gore. https://app.redwood/POC-12577

derek_gore: Proposed cadence: default = quarterly deltas (included). Monthly cadence available as SLA upgrade. Emergency hotfixes (48h) available for paid add-on; rollback doc included in acceptance checklist. We require customer-scheduled maintenance window for any offline apply.

mika_hyun: Pricing sketch for sales: baseline offline package = $16k/yr/site (packaging, signed manifests, 1 quarterly delta). Monthly deltas = +$7k/yr/site. Hotfix SLA (48h) = +$5k/yr/site or per-event pricing. Travel/onsite billed T&M.

anu_desai: Example minimal manifest (demo):
```
{
  "manifest_version": "1",
  "site_id": "acme-west-1",
  "bundles": ["runtime-4.1.zst","models/small-gptq-v1"],
  "delta": true,
  "checksum": "sha256:abcd...",
  "sig": "MEUCIQ..."
}
```

legal_ollie: Pre-SOW checklist we need answered: SBOM acceptance, root CA exchange method, whether customer wants us to sign (we do by default) or they will provide signed manifests, telemetry/diagnostics opt-out, and indemnity language for offline deliverables. I can draft SOW clause and questionnaire.

derek_gore: Plan: 30m kickoff Wed 11am PT. Agenda: show `redwood-offline-apply` on VM, demo signature verification (end-to-end if they provide root cert), walk rollforward/rollback steps, discuss cadence + pricing, and collect answers to legal checklist. Can folks join?

mika_hyun: I'll run the customer intro and invite procurement.

anu_desai: I'll prepare a signed demo delta + checksums and a short runbook for "bring your own media". ETA: Tue EOD.

legal_ollie: I'll attach questionnaire and a sample SOW clause before the call.

mika_hyun: Great, thanks team. If Acme can provide their root cert we can demo full verify flow. :thumbsup:
